hints.title: Bipartite Condition
hints.text: Adjacent nodes must belong to groups with difference exactly 1. A valid grouping is possible if and only if each connected component is bipartite (has no odd cycles).

hints.title: Per-Component Breadth Traversal
hints.text: For each bipartite component, running a breadth-first search from a node produces group layers equal to the maximum distance from that root plus 1.

hints.title: Component-Wise Diameter Maximization
hints.text: For each component, evaluate BFS from all candidate vertices in that component. Take the maximum layers achieved and sum these maximums across all components.

hints.title: Bipartite Check and Multi-Source BFS Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS from every vertex across components to maximize layer count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking partition assignments blows up exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for graph adjacency lists and component buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes equivalence to bipartite graph layer diameter and aggregates maximal component depths.
